user.title: United Utilities
user.description: Your account must already be registered in the United Utilities app. Use the app PIN, not your website password. The account locks for about an hour after 3 wrong attempts, so check the details before submitting.

data_description.account_number: Your water account number, as shown on your bill.
data_description.postcode: The postcode of the property on the account. Used once to find your app customer ID; not stored.
data_description.pin: The PIN you use to log in to the United Utilities app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate United Utilities
reauth_confirm.description: United Utilities rejected the stored PIN. Enter the postcode and your current app PIN. The account locks for about an hour after 3 wrong attempts.

error.invalid_auth: The PIN was rejected. Each wrong PIN counts toward the 3-attempt lockout.
error.no_match: No United Utilities account matches that account number and postcode.
error.not_registered: This account isn't registered in the United Utilities app yet. Register in the app, then try again.
error.account_locked: United Utilities has locked this account after too many failed attempts. Wait about an hour before trying again.
error.invalid_account: This account number isn't linked to that login.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to United Utilities.

pin_rejected.message: United Utilities rejected the PIN (attempts left before lockout: {attempts_remaining}). Reauthenticate with your current app PIN.

pin_previously_rejected.message: United Utilities rejected the stored PIN earlier, so it won't be tried again. Reauthenticate with your current app PIN.

bill_unreadable.title: United Utilities bill couldn't be read reliably
